purpose: Raw same-band and different-band measurement review. No depthwise/bandwise merge, QR2/QR3 correction or stretch applied.
units: IMAGE, ZODI, IMAGE−ZODI: MJy/sr; VARIANCE: (MJy/sr)^2. Native planes are FITS order; common grid is north-up PNG order. Nearest-pixel sampling is retained, not precision resampling.
